description_ru: Кандидатка на должность и скептичный директор торгуются о зарплате и должностных титулах. Сухая ирония и деловой английский.
text:
Castellan: Do sit down, Ms. Rao. I trust the lift was not too much of an ordeal.
Priya: It was a lift, Mr. Castellan. I survived it. Shall we discuss the offer?
Castellan: Directly to business. I admire that, and I am obliged to say that it costs you three points.
Priya: Three points of what?
Castellan: Charm. We keep a private tally. Now, the position. We are prepared to offer you the title of Senior Associate Strategist, at a salary I am delighted to describe as "competitive".
Priya: Competitive with whom?
Castellan: With itself. Last year's figure, I mean.
Priya: Then perhaps we could discuss the figure rather than the adjective.
Castellan: Forty-eight thousand.
Priya: I currently earn fifty-six, with a bonus, and I do not have to say "synergy" before lunch.
Castellan: Ah. You have been told about the synergy.
Priya: Everyone has been told about the synergy.
Castellan: Let me be candid. The budget is, shall we say, under reflection. But we can be flexible on the title. How would you feel about Principal?
Priya: Principal of what?
Castellan: That is the beauty of it. The title has been left deliberately open.
Priya: In my experience, titles that cost nothing are generally worth precisely that.
Castellan: You are unsentimental, Ms. Rao. Splendid. I find sentiment so inefficient in a negotiator.
Priya: Then let me be efficient. I will accept fifty-four, a pension contribution matched at six per cent, and an additional week of leave.
Castellan: A week. Of leave. You do realise there are only fifty-two of them in a year?
Priya: I have counted. It leaves fifty-one for you to enjoy my work.
Castellan: Hm. That was rather good. Plus one point for charm.
Priya: So I am up to minus two.
Castellan: You are a fast learner. Now, in the spirit of mutual transparency, I should mention that the role does involve a certain amount of travel.
Priya: How much is a certain amount?
Castellan: Between forty and sixty per cent.
Priya: Of my time, or of my sanity?
Castellan: We have never measured the second.
Priya: Then I shall want that in writing, along with the first. Travel capped at forty per cent, and flights, within reason, in a seat with a window.
Castellan: You do understand that I am not a magician.
Priya: And you do understand that I am not a charity. Forgive me. I mean that kindly.
Castellan: I took it in that spirit. Very well. I cannot do fifty-four, but I could manage fifty-one, a six per cent pension, and the week.
Priya: Fifty-three, and I withdraw my request about the window.
Castellan: You are bargaining with your own windows.
Priya: It is a mark of how much I want the job.
Castellan: Is it? Because until now, I had assumed you were mildly insulted by it.
Priya: Both things can be true. It is a very good company with a rather peculiar vocabulary.
Castellan: Fifty-two. Final offer.
Priya: Fifty-two, the week, the pension, and the title Principal.
Castellan: Principal of what?
Priya: I rather thought we would leave that open.
Castellan: Ms. Rao, I am going to enjoy working with you, and I fear I am going to regret it.
Priya: Please put both in the contract.

ʌ: краткий, расслабленный звук между «а» и «ы»: much, budget, company.
Звуки p, t, k в начале ударного слога произносите с лёгким выдохом воздуха: position, time, cannot.
